input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns clause: it neither confirms our right to assign to an affiliate or M&A successor nor restricts HDI, so HDI (the hosting provider) could freely assign the agreement, including to a competitor of the Company. There is no change-of-control provision anywhere in the agreement (searches for "change of control" return nothing, and the termination provisions in §§ 1.x/2.x contain no change-of-control trigger), so no walk-away issue exists, but the clause falls short of the preferred asymmetric position. The redline adds the Customer affiliate/successor carve-out, requires our consent (not unreasonably withheld) for HDI assignments with a competitor bar, and confirms that a change of control of the Company is not an assignment and creates no HDI termination or re-pricing right.

proposal.summary: Add Company affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, consent restriction on HDI assignment, and confirm no HDI rights on Company change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 is silent on consent, so as drafted HDI could assign the hosting relationship to anyone, including a competitor of ours. We have made the clause asymmetric consistent with our playbook: we may assign freely to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets, HDI may assign only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor, and a change of control of the Company gives HDI no termination or re-pricing right. If helpful, we can accept a mutual notice-based right to assign to successors with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. The Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without HDI's consent, to an affiliate of the Company or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the Company's prior written consent (which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company. No change of control of the Company shall be deemed an assignment or give rise to any right of HDI to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
